color.summary: Greys with no hue. Ink is #0d0d0d, quiet text #5d5d5d, soft fills #ededed and edges #d8d8d8 to #e6e6e6. The app's page is #fcfcfc in light and pure #000 in dark (the component library sits on #fff and #212121). Primary actions are filled in the ink color, not a brand hue. Blue (#0169cc light, #0285ff dark) is kept for links and focus rings; green #00a240, orange #e25507, red #e02e2a and purple #8046d9 tint the status tones.
usage: Each tone has a soft form: a pale fill under a darker ink of the same hue (#daf4e4 under #008635 for success).

type.summary: No web font: the system stack (Apple's system face on a Mac). 16/24 for body text, 14px at 500 on buttons and controls, 14/20 for secondary copy, 12/18 for small labels. Titles are 600: 24/36 for page headings, 16/24 for dialog titles.

shape.summary: Buttons, switches and the app's select triggers are pills. In the library, inputs, cards and code blocks have 8px corners and badges and checkboxes 4px. The signed-in app is rounder: 16px on cards, dialogs, menus and tooltips, 12px on menu rows, 24px on the banner alert; the composer is a 52px pill.

spacing.summary: A long size scale from 3xs (22px) to 3xl (48px); the library defaults to md at 32px and the app's controls are 36px with 12px padding. Menu rows are 32px with 8px padding in the library, 36px with 10px padding in the app.

elevation.summary: Edges are drawn as 1px inset rings in ink at 16% (white at 25% in dark). The app's menus add a 0.5px ring under 0 8px 16px -4px at 12%, and dialogs 0 4px 8px -2px at 10%. The library's surface tooltip floats on 0 10px 15px -3px plus 0 4px 6px -4px at 10%; the segmented control's indicator sits on a small 0 1px 4px -1px drop. Focus is a 2px blue outline 2px out.

button.summary: The Apps SDK UI Button: solid, soft, outline and ghost, each a pill, across nine sizes. Solid fills in the ink color and inverts in dark. Pressing scales a button to 97%.

ghost.note: No fill until hover, a #5d5d5d icon: the code block's copy button.
